NewsArticle.Title: Internet Connection
NewsArticle.Content: Internet Service Provider has fixed their problem. On 08/24, from 10 a.m. - 4 p.m., an Internet Service Provider near Dark Ages servers suffered internet latency. We diligently pressed the issue with the ISP to fix their problem. If you notice internet latency while playing, do not risk death. Character losses due to internet latency are not restored. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
